1034.description: A machine move that presses the leg out to the side, working the outer hips.
instructions: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

1098.description: A side plank with your feet in the straps. It strengthens the obliques and stabilisers.
instructions: Lie on your side with feet in the straps and your elbow below your shoulder.
Lift your hips.
Hold a straight line.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

1162.description: A strict standing overhead press with a barbell. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
instructions: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

1226.description: An overhead press with an EZ bar. The angled grips can feel kinder on the wrists while you train the shoulders.
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar at your upper chest with a comfortable grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it slowly back to your chest.
Keep your head neutral and avoid leaning back.

1290.description: A single-arm dumbbell press done seated or lying on a stability ball. Balance and core control are part of every rep.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and position it at shoulder height, with your elbow bent and palm facing forward.
Slowly press the dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended, while keeping your core engaged and maintaining balance on the exercise ball.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
一只手握住哑铃，将其置于与肩同高的位置，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
慢慢向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展，同时保持核心收紧并在健身球上保持平衡。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

1354.description: Lift a medicine ball overhead and slam it into the floor with force. It builds full body power and trains the lats, core and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands above your head.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Bend your knees slightly and forcefully slam the medicine ball down to the ground in front of you.
As you slam the ball down, use your entire body to generate power, including your shoulders and core.
Catch the ball on the bounce and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住药球举过头顶。
启动你的核心并保持背部挺直。
稍微弯曲膝盖，用力将药球摔到你面前的地面上。
当你击球时，用你的整个身体来产生力量，包括你的肩膀和核心。
接住球的弹跳并重复所需的重复次数。

1418.description: Stand and pull one knee up to your chest with both hands. It stretches the glutes and loosens the hip and lower back.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat position.
As you squat down, bring your knees up towards your chest and hug them with your arms.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
当你蹲下时，将膝盖抬向胸部，并用手臂抱住它们。
保持这个姿势一会儿，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1482.description: A gentle yoga backbend that opens the chest and stretches the front of the abs while strengthening the back.
instructions: Lie on your stomach with your palms under your shoulders and legs extended.
Press the tops of your feet into the floor.
Lift your chest by straightening your arms partway, keeping your hips down.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and your neck long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

1546.description: A squat with your back against a wall, which keeps your torso upright and takes pressure off the lower back. Good for building leg endurance.
instructions: Lean your back against a wall with your feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to slide back up.
Repeat for the planned number of reps.

1610.description: A forearm exercise where you hold the bar behind your back and roll it down to your fingertips. It builds grip and forearm strength.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips.
Curl your fingers closed and lift the bar back into your palms.
Curl your wrists up a little at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

1674.description: A hammer curl lying chest down on an incline bench. It trains the brachialis and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the bench to a 45-degree incline.
Lie face down on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Allow your arms to hang straight down towards the floor, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将长凳调整至 45 度倾斜。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
让你的手臂垂直垂向地板，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1738.description: A one-arm overhead extension done seated with an underhand grip on the dumbbell. It works the triceps through a long, stretched range.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip and extend your arm straight up overhead.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至头顶。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到头后，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1802.description: Bending sideways with an arm overhead lengthens the lat and the side of your trunk. A quick stretch for the flanks.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side from the raised arm, reaching over without twisting.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1866.description: Wide-grip pull-up performed on the dip cage that emphasises the lats.
instructions: Grab the wide handles with your palms facing forward.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back.
Pause when your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

1930.description: A deep crouch with the heels pressed back to stretch the calves and Achilles area.
instructions: Crouch down with your feet flat and hands on the floor for balance.
Shift one heel backward and press it toward the floor.
Keep the other leg bent and supporting your weight.
Feel the stretch in the calf of the pressing leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2122.description: A partner helps guide a sideways bend of the trunk, making it easier to relax into the stretch along the flank.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and one arm overhead.
Have your partner stand behind you with a hand on your hip and a hand on your raised arm.
Lean sideways as your partner gently guides the movement.
Tell your partner to stop at a mild pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return upright and switch sides.

2186.description: A decline EZ bar triceps extension lowering the bar toward your forehead. Builds triceps strength.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and your feet secured.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头低于脚，双脚固定。
正手握住 ez 杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
将杠铃慢慢降低到前额，弯曲肘部。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2314.description: A machine crunch performed lying back, targeting the abdominal muscles with adjustable resistance.
instructions: Lie back on the machine and set your feet or hands as the machine requires.
Grip the handles lightly and set your lower back against the pad.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch up.
Exhale and squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

2570.description: A kneeling Pilates move where one bent leg draws circles in the air. It works the glutes and hips while the core keeps you steady.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee bent.
Draw slow circles in the air with your knee.
Keep your hips level and your spine still.
Switch direction, then repeat on the other leg.

2762.description: Pointing the foot away from the shin, engaging the calf. Good for warming up and mobilising the ankle.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed.
Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal.
Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2890.description: A move that moves from forearm plank to full push-up position, training the chest, arms and core.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other.
Reach a high plank with straight arms.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and keep your hips level.

2954.description: A standing curl with an overhand grip on a straight cable bar. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Stand facing a low cable with a straight bar in an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

3018.description: A bodyweight calf raise that builds lower-leg strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Hold a wall for balance if needed.

3338.description: A single leg hinge holding a dumbbell, which trains your hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.

3402.description: A pike push-up with your hands on two chairs so your head can drop lower.
instructions: Set two sturdy chairs shoulder-width apart and grip them.
Walk your feet back and lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the chairs.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly in.
Press back up.
Make sure the chairs are stable.

3466.description: A dynamic lunge warm-up drill (part 6 of 7) that opens the hips and prepares your legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced.
Step into the lunge position described by this variation with control.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Move smoothly through the full range without bouncing.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
Do 8-10 slow reps per side as part of a warm-up.

3530.description: A barbell squat with bands attached to increase tension at the top.
instructions: Set the bands on the rack and barbell.
Rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Brace your core throughout.

3658.description: Sit with your back against a pad to hold a proper seated posture.
instructions: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Press your back gently into the pad.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position and breathe.

3722.description: A chest-supported raise with a barbell that isolates the rear shoulders.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell hanging below you.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the bar by lifting your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your rear delts at the top.
Lower the barbell slowly.

3786.description: A squat combined with a one-arm band row. It trains your legs and your back together.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and the band under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your chest up.
Stand up and, at the top, pull the handle to your ribs with your elbow close to your body, then let it return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3850.description: A reverse curl using a towel looped around both feet. It trains your biceps and forearms.
instructions: Lie on your back and loop a towel around both feet.
Hold the ends with an overhand grip.
Pull the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

3914.description: A row with wide elbows on the cable machine that targets the rear delts.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height with a handle or rope.
Hold it with your arms extended.
Step back and lean slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts.
Return slowly.

3978.description: Seated crunch with the legs swinging to one side and then the other. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit and lean back on your hands, legs lifted.
Swing both knees to one side while crunching in.
Return through the middle.
Swing to the other side.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

4042.description: Seated trunk rotation pulling a cable across the body. It works the obliques and deep core.
instructions: Sit next to a cable machine set at chest height and grab the handle with both hands.
Start with your arms extended in front of you.
Rotate your torso away from the stack, pulling the handle across your body.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your hips still, finish the reps, then switch sides.

4106.description: An anti-rotation press from a split stance that teaches your core to resist twisting.
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Return the handle to your chest, then switch sides.

4170.description: A plank on hands and toes with knees hovering just off the floor. It challenges the core and shoulders.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Brace your abs and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your knees to rest.

4234.description: A one-arm reverse wrist curl, palm down, seated with a weight. It strengthens the top of the forearm.
instructions: Sit and rest one forearm on your thigh, palm down.
Let your hand hang over your knee with the weight.
Lower your wrist for a stretch.
Lift your hand up as high as you can.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

4362.description: A barbell back squat with a two second pause at the bottom, removing bounce and building strength.
instructions: Set a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down into a deep squat.
Pause for two seconds at the bottom.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout.

4426.description: A chest-supported row with a wide elbow path that emphasises the upper back and rear delts.
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the dumbbells up with elbows flaring out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control.

4490.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the upper trapezius. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your upper trapezius while leaning back against a wall.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4554.description: A seated figure-four stretch that lengthens the glutes and outer hip.
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with your back tall.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Keep your back straight and lean your chest forward slowly.
Feel the stretch in the glute of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

4618.description: A hip hinge using a band under your feet for rising tension, working the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and grab it with both hands.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Lower your hands along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep the band close to your body.

4682.description: A bent-over fly with a band. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slight elbow bends.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

4746.description: A windmill with a dumbbell held low, bending sideways and down the leg. It trains the obliques and loosens the hips.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand.
Turn your back foot out and push your hips toward the dumbbell side.
Slide the dumbbell down your leg as you bend sideways and hinge.
Keep both legs mostly straight.
Return to standing and finish the set, then switch sides.

4810.description: A standing bend to the side, a second variation. It works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and one arm overhead.
Brace your core lightly.
Bend sideways at the waist, reaching over with the raised arm.
Pause when you feel the side muscles work.
Return to upright with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

4938.description: A gentle wrist movement that tilts the hand toward the thumb side. It improves wrist mobility.
instructions: Rest your forearm on a table with your hand off the edge.
Keep your palm facing in.
Tilt your hand up toward the thumb side.
Return to neutral slowly.
Keep your forearm still.
Do equal reps on both wrists.

5002.description: A light dumbbell raise along a Y-shaped path. It trains the shoulders and the muscles of the upper back.
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell in one hand and hinge slightly or lie chest down on an incline bench.
Start with your arm hanging down.
Raise your arm diagonally overhead to form a Y with your thumb up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, and switch sides.

5066.description: Squat with dumbbells at your shoulders, then press them overhead as you stand. A full-body move that links leg drive into a press.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

5130.description: A floor dip with hands behind you and hips lifted. It trains the triceps with just your bodyweight.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands behind you.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing back.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

5194.description: An advanced pull-up that transitions into a dip above a bar. It builds serious pulling and pushing strength.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false or standard grip.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean forward and rotate your wrists over the bar.
Press up until your arms are fully straight.
Lower yourself back down with control.

5386.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the upper back and shoulders. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Place the roller under the upper back and shoulders and let your body weight settle onto it.
Sweep your arms in a wide arc overhead, like a snow angel.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5450.description: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps. Gives your biceps a burn.
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Do 7 full-range curls.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.

5514.description: Crunch with legs raised and a rotation at the top that hits the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and legs raised.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Crunch up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat to the other side.
Do not pull on your neck.

5706.description: A deadlift with the bar between your legs and a split stance. It loads the legs and hips and trains the back to stay braced.
instructions: Stand straddling the bar with one foot forward and one back.
Squat down and grip the bar with one hand in front and one behind.
Brace your core and lift your chest.
Stand up by driving through both legs.
Lower the bar with control and switch your stance on the next set.

5898.description: A standing forward fold with one leg back. Deeply stretches the back of the front leg.
instructions: Step one foot back with both feet facing forward.
Keep both legs straight and your hips square.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long back.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise slowly and switch legs.

6026.description: A side plank with a pulling arm motion, to build core stability and shoulder strength.
instructions: Get into a side plank on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Reach your top arm overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

6218.description: An incline press where you rotate the dumbbells during the press. It works the upper chest.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Palms face you.
Press up, rotating your palms forward.
Lock out at the top.
Lower, rotating back.
Keep your shoulders down.

6794.description: A hip flexor length test where you lie on the edge of a bench and see how freely the thigh hangs.
instructions: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

6986.description: A wall-assisted version of a downward dog push-up with a push off at the top. It trains the shoulders in a bent-hip position.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it with hips back.
Lower your head toward the wall, bending the elbows.
Push explosively away from the wall.
Land softly back into the start position.
Keep your core braced and back flat.

7114.description: A vertical pull with an EZ bar that builds the side shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand tall holding the EZ bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs.
Pull it up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height without shrugging hard.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

7306.description: A gentle side stretch for the neck and upper traps, useful after desk work.
instructions: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder.
Rest a hand lightly on your head for slight pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

7562.description: Seated stretch for the front of your thigh.
instructions: Sit sideways on a bench or chair edge.
Bend one knee, tucking your foot behind you.
Hold your ankle and gently pull it toward your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

7626.description: A squat holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The angled bar helps you stay upright and load the legs.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

7882.description: An explosive push of a weight plate out from your chest for upper-body power.
instructions: Stand with a weight plate held at your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your abs and bend your knees slightly.
Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Fully extend your arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

8202.description: A seated move combining a leg out to the side with a twist. It gently works the hips and waist.
instructions: Sit tall near the edge of a chair.
Lift one leg and open it out to the side.
Twist your torso toward that leg.
Return to centre.
Alternate sides.

9610.description: A forward lunge holding a plate overhead. It trains the legs while challenging shoulder stability and the core.
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the plate steady.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

9866.description: A belt-machine deadlift using a straight bar, so the load hangs from your hips.
instructions: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the straight bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

9930.description: A hybrid of a skull crusher and a bench press where the bar lowers toward the forehead then presses up and back over the chest. It hits the chest and triceps together.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher.
As it nears your head, let the elbows travel down so the bar moves toward the upper chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Lower again along the same path and repeat.
Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.

9994.description: A lying hip adduction hold squeezing a ball between the knees. It trains the inner thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Release slowly.
Repeat for several reps.

10058.description: A floor-to-stand drill moving from kneeling to half kneeling, alternating sides. It builds hip mobility and control.
instructions: Kneel upright with both knees on the floor.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Pause and keep your torso tall.
Step back to full kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot.
Move slowly and use your arms for balance if needed.

10186.description: A glute bridge combined with a pullover and press, training the hips, chest and triceps in one flow.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the dumbbell back overhead in a pullover arc.
Pull it back over your chest and press it straight up.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, keeping your ribs down.

10762.description: A sideways walk on tiptoe. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk one way, then return.

10890.description: Toe jumps on an elastic bed. It trains calves and ankle bounce.
instructions: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.

11274.description: A standing diagonal cable press done one arm at a time. It trains the chest and challenges your core.
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance holding a high cable handle in each hand.
Brace your core.
Press one handle forward and down diagonally.
Return slowly and press with the other arm.
Alternate for the set without twisting your hips.

11786.description: A gentle seated nerve glide that moves the radial nerve along the arm.
instructions: Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back.
Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward.
Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away.
Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

0010.description: An assisted hanging knee raise that ends with the legs dropping back down under control. Trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, keeping your legs together.
Once your knees are at chest level, explosively throw your legs down towards the ground, extending them fully.
Allow your legs to swing back up and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心并将膝盖抬向胸部，保持双腿并拢。
一旦你的膝盖与胸部齐平，爆发性地将你的双腿向地面扔去，将它们完全伸展。
让双腿向后摆动并重复该动作达到所需的重复次数。

0074.description: A partial deadlift from a rack at knee height. Overloads the upper back, glutes and hips.
instructions: Set up a barbell on a rack at knee height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outwards.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower yourself down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lift the barbell by extending your hips and knees, pulling your shoulders back and squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position by bending at the hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠铃放在膝盖高度的架子上。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，降低身体高度，正手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
通过伸展臀部和膝盖、向后拉肩膀并在顶部挤压臀部来收紧核心并举起杠铃。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0138.description: A bodyweight ab exercise that rocks the hips up toward the ceiling. Works the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and bring them towards your chest, keeping your feet off the ground.
Engaging your abs, lift your hips off the ground, bringing your knees towards your head.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖并将其靠近胸部，保持双脚离开地面。
收紧腹肌，将臀部抬离地面，将膝盖靠近头部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0202.description: A one-arm cable row with a stirrup handle, aimed at the rear delts. You pull back and squeeze the shoulder blade, then switch sides.
instructions: Attach a stirrup handle to a low cable pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the handle with your left hand and take a step back with your right foot, positioning your body at a slight angle.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
With your left arm extended and your palm facing down, pull the handle towards your chest by retracting your shoulder blade.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with your right arm.
instructionsZh: 将马镫手柄连接到低电缆滑轮上，面向机器站立。
左手抓住手柄，右脚后退一步，身体保持一个轻微的角度。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
左臂伸展，手掌朝下，通过缩回肩胛骨将手柄拉向胸部。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压肩胛骨。
慢慢地将手柄释放回起始位置，然后重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用右臂重复练习。

0330.description: A dumbbell triceps extension on an incline bench. You lower the weights behind the head and extend to target the triceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the dumbbells behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbells back to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
将手臂完全伸过头顶，保持肘部靠近头部。
弯曲肘部，将哑铃降低到头后，保持上臂静止。
暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将哑铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0394.description: Seated and bent forward, you straighten your arms behind you with dumbbells. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your upper arms close to your sides and keep your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，从臀部向前倾斜，保持背部挺直。
将上臂靠近身体两侧，并保持肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将手臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0458.description: Lying on the floor, you open your arms and press a barbell up. The floor limits the range, so it is easy on the shoulders while it works the chest.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, arms extended straight up over your chest.
Slowly lower the barbell out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the barbell until your arms are parallel to the floor, feeling a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧在地板上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住杠铃，双臂伸直越过胸部。
慢慢地将杠铃向两侧放低，保持肘部轻微弯曲。
降低杠铃，直到手臂与地板平行，感觉胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后挤压胸部肌肉，使杠铃回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0522.description: You row a kettlebell with one arm after the other. It builds the back, biceps and grip.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a kettlebell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull one kettlebell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，双手各握一个壶铃，手掌朝向身体。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将一个壶铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
将壶铃放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

0586.description: Lying face down on a machine, you curl your heels toward your glutes. Isolates the hamstrings.
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Lie face down on the machine with your legs straight and your heels against the padded lever.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting your hips off the pad.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体并选择所需的重量。
面朝下躺在机器上，双腿伸直，脚跟靠在带衬垫的杠杆上。
抓住机器的手柄或侧面以保持稳定性。
保持上半身静止，呼气并尽可能向上弯曲双腿，但不要将臀部抬离垫子。
挤压腿筋时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并缓慢地将控制杆降低回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0650.description: Hands on the floor and feet on a stability ball, you pull the ball toward your chest. Works the abs and hip flexors while challenging balance.
instructions: Start by sitting on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands on the sides of the stability ball for support.
Engage your abs and slowly roll your hips forward, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
将双手放在稳定球的两侧以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前滚动臀部，使膝盖靠近胸部。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢将双腿伸展回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0714.description: A side plank variation held on one forearm. It builds the obliques and shoulder stability.
instructions: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Stack your feet or stagger them.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Keep your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

0778.description: A push-up combined with a knee drive toward the elbow, like a crawling spider. It trains the chest, core and hips together.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow, keeping it off the ground.
As you bring your right knee back, simultaneously lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position and repeat with your left knee towards your left elbow.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，双脚并拢。
将右膝靠近右肘，使其离开地面。
当您将右膝向后拉时，同时弯曲肘部将身体降低到地面。
推回起始位置，然后将左膝朝向左肘重复此动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0842.description: A pullover with a weight while lying across a stability ball. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie with your upper back on the ball, hips lifted.
Hold a weight with both hands above your chest.
Lower it back over your head with slightly bent arms.
Pull it back up over your chest.
Keep your core tight and hips high.

0906.description: A kneeling glute kick against a band. It strengthens the glutes with a stable base.
instructions: Get on all fours with the band around one foot and in your hands.
Keep your core tight.
Kick the banded leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

0970.description: A pull-up with a band looped under the feet for assistance. It builds the lats and biceps while you work toward unassisted pull-ups.
instructions: Attach the band to a pull-up bar or sturdy anchor point.
Step onto the band and grip the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, keeping your core engaged and your shoulders down and back.
Pull your body up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在上拉杆或坚固的锚点上。
踏上弹力带，手掌背向自己，握住杠铃，双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展，保持核心收紧，肩膀向下并向后倾斜。
将肩胛骨挤压在一起并将肘部向下推向臀部，将身体向上拉向杠铃杆。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
